# Main

<!-- Generated by `prism docs` from `src/Main.pr`. Do not edit by hand. -->

The standalone Spectra executable: parse the command line (`SpectraCli`), dispatch to the build orchestration (`SpectraBuild`), exit with its status.

```text
prism build packages/spectra --out ./spectra
./spectra check examples/spectra-deck
./spectra build examples/spectra-deck --output deck.pdf --open
```
